portfolio.title: European transport management
portfolio.description: Blue Yonder TMS transformation across six countries, combining process redesign, platform implementation and automation.

sections.heading: Transformation scope
items: Analyzed transport scheduling and execution processes; redesigned operating workflows to optimize internal resource use.
Implemented Blue Yonder TMS across six countries, supporting more than 1,000 users.
Designed and launched the SpotBuy platform and its supporting business processes.
Delivered a weight-per-shipment optimization module and modeled multi-trip operations with TMod.
Introduced SmartBench and automated key planning and execution activities.

sections.heading: Business outcomes
items: Optimized workload equivalent to 20 FTE.
Increased average weight per shipment by 0.15 tonnes.
Identified $1.6M in SpotBuy cost reductions.
Improved integration stability by 25%.
Achieved 57% touchless processing and a 12% improvement in OTIF.

portfolio.title: End-to-end planning and scheduling platform
portfolio.description: Integrated demand, supply and scheduling capabilities delivered across o9 and Infor platforms.

sections.heading: Transformation scope
items: Implemented o9 and Infor capabilities across an integrated end-to-end planning landscape.
Introduced heuristic forecasting and designed planning scenarios to support decision-making.
Established S&OP ways of working and connected demand and supply planning.
Implemented digital decoupling across integrations to improve resilience and changeability.
Optimized safety-stock settings and coordinated planning across sites.

sections.heading: Business outcomes
items: Improved forecast accuracy by 15%.
Reduced inter-site movements by 20%.
Improved OSS by 12%.
Optimized safety stock while protecting service levels.
Improved platform stability from 77% to 93% and delivered $1.5M in savings.

portfolio.title: Agentic AI for inventory obsolescence
portfolio.description: A decision-support concept applying AI agents to identify at-risk inventory and recommend redistribution actions.

sections.heading: Concept
items: Apply agentic AI to detect emerging obsolescence risks across inventory positions.
Combine demand, stock and product context to prioritize redistribution opportunities.
Support planners with explainable recommendations and human approval before execution.

sections.heading: Value potential
items: A $1.2M business case was identified for the proposed concept.
The figure represents estimated opportunity, not realized savings.
